title: Wave
summary: Turn your voice into text — local or cloud, your choice
content: Wave: Turn your voice into text — local or cloud, your choice | Product Hunt Launching today Wave Launching today Turn your voice into text — local or cloud, your choice 401 followers Turn your voice into text — local or cloud, your choice 401 followers Visit website AI Dictation Apps • Transcription Wave lets you invoke an AI model anywhere on macOS using just your voice. Hold a hotkey, speak, and release—your speech is transcribed, processed, and the result appears exactly where you need it. If you're typing, it replaces or inserts text. If you're reading, it shows a floating answer. Works across all apps with selected text as context. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team Awards More Free Launch tags: Productivity • GitHub • Audio Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 2 Day Rank Upvote • 259 points Follow Wave Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info wave.mxv.sh GitHub Wave Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/wave-16 AssemblyAI Voice Agent API One API to build production-ready voice agents Try Voice Agent API Promoted Similar Products Wispr Flow Speak naturally, write perfectly & 4x faster in every app 4.7 ( 70 reviews ) AI Dictation Apps TalkTastic Voice Keyboard that Understands Your Personal Context 4.9 ( 26 reviews ) Text-to-Speech Software AI Dictation Apps superwhisper Extremely accurate, voice to text for Mac & iPhone 4.9 ( 20 reviews ) AI Dictation Apps AudioPen The easiest way to convert messy thoughts into clear text 4.9 ( 68 reviews ) Writing assistants Text-to-Speech Software Typeless AI voice dictation that's actually intelligent 5.0 ( 10 reviews ) Writing assistants AI Dictation Apps View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer Launch websites with enterprise needs at startup speeds. Try Framer Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Monawwar Abdullah Drivebase Maker 📌 Hey everyone 👋 Wave is a simple idea done properly: speech to text that doesn’t lock you in. Most tools either: * limit you to one model * force cloud usage * or stop at basic transcription Wave focuses on doing two things well: 1. Speech → text (Whisper-based) * Fast, accurate transcription * Works locally for privacy * Or via APIs if you want 2. AI mode * Take your speech or selected text * Refine, rewrite, or transform it * Use the model you prefer No subscriptions, no lock-in — just a flexible tool you can actually control. What’s coming next: * Context-aware processing * Per-app behavior (different rules per workflow) * More customization around how text is handled Everything is free and open. Would love to hear how you’d use it or what feels missing 🙌 Upvote (8) Report Share 2mo ago Suryansh @monawwar Interesting concept is there any way of contribution? It is a daily sync, so 'active' jobs are active as of that morning. You start to see patterns for when jobs are added / pulled and this aligns roughly with what companies do. Because we keep inactive jobs, if you chose to look back at older listings, you can. Otherwise, if it is active, regardless of how long it has been up, it is fresh. Upvote Report Share 10h ago Habib Ferdous The normalization layer is where I'd want to understand the depth of work done. Thirty-plus ATSs means thirty-plus ways to express job title, seniority, and employment type — and raw aggregation without opinionated normalization just moves the cleanup problem to whoever's consuming the API. How standardized are fields like seniority level or work location across sources, or is that still left to the builder?
